forecast-period.text: A trough of low pressure over the northeast will linger over the far northeast until mid week. A cold front clips the southeast on Monday, followed by a high pressure system, which will then move across southern parts of the state on Tuesday. A trough of low pressure approaches the western border on Wednesday whilst a cold font moves over waters to the south. The trough lingers near the western border on Thursday whilst a high pressure systems moves over waters to the south.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Isolated showers about the southern agricultural area, clearing by the evening. Showers and thunderstorms about the northeast, contracting to the far northeast. Maximum temperatures below average, tending to above average in the far northeast. West to southwesterly winds about the south, fresh at times. Winds tending south to southeasterly winds about the north, freshening at times about the far north.

Showers about the northern agricultural areas and adjacent parts to the north, contracting to the northeast later. Gusty thunderstorms near the eastern border contracting to the northeast later. Isolated showers redevelop about the southern and western coasts late. Fresh and gusty north to northwesterly winds in the north east ahead of a fresh and gusty west to southwesterly change extending throughout.
Afternoon showers and thunderstorms about the far north. Maximum temperatures generally below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending easterly in the west.
Showers and thunderstorms developing about the far west later. Maximum temperatures average to above average. South to southeasterly winds tending northeasterly in the west.

text.p: Showers and thunderstorms about the west and north, mostly likely about the far north. Maximum temperatures average to above average, grading to below average about the far west. Southeast to northeasterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Thursday: 1 to 5 mm about the agricultural areas, far north and far west with local falls of 5 to 10 mm possible about the far northwest. Localised falls between 10 to 30 mm are possible with thunderstorms mostly about the far north.
